description: Fix runtime crashes: remove duplicate Remotes from .rbxlx (server creates them), restructure Workspace to not include raw destructible Parts (ZoneService spawns them dynamically), fix client RenderStepped nil access on HP/MaxHP IntValues, add nil guard for playerData
steps: Update generate_rbxlx.py: Remove the Remotes folder from ReplicatedStorage (server Main creates it at runtime)

Update generate_rbxlx.py: Remove all destructible Parts (CoinPile, DiamondPile, Crate, UrbanCrate, UrbanCoinPile) from Workspace - ZoneService spawns them dynamically with proper DestructibleId children
Keep only SpawnLocation, zone ground baseplates (Zone1_GrueneWiesen, Zone2_Stadt), CampaignPortal, ZoneGate, Terrain, Camera in Workspace
Fix Main.client.lua RenderStepped: remove check for HP/MaxHP IntValues since server does not create them on Parts - the client learns HP only through DestructibleDamaged events
Add nil guard in Main.client.lua: if GetPlayerData returns nil, use default empty data
acceptance_criteria: No Remotes folder in .rbxlx ReplicatedStorage (server creates it)
No raw destructible Parts in Workspace (ZoneService creates them with DestructibleId at runtime)
Workspace still contains SpawnLocation, zone baseplates, CampaignPortal, ZoneGate
Client RenderStepped does not crash on nil HP/MaxHP IntValues
verification: Run: PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 python -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('/projects/Roblox-game/BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('Valid')"
Verify no CoinPile/DiamondPile/Crate Parts in .rbxlx workspace
